body.p: After . Owns src/xpath_lower.c, src/xpath_lower_internal.h, src/xpath_static.c, src/xpath_static_internal.h, tests/xpath_static_test.c, tests/ir_test.c. Every construct Phase 1 left unlowered (171 cases): for member, for key/value, destructuring let (157), dynamic node tests (43), the item axis (24); keyword arguments of constructor functions (misc-ConstructorKeywords, 148); focus functions fn { } (misc-FocusConstructors, 148); named function references to every kind of function (prod-NamedFunctionRef, 144). Done when no XP40 case fails for "not lowered" and those sets reach ≥ 90%. Spec: XPath 4.0 "For Expressions", "Let Expressions", "Named Function References", "Inline Function Expressions". Done 2026-10-17 (): no XP40 case is "not lowered" except the computed constructors (Phase 3); ForClause.map/.member, LetClause, MethodCall, ConstructorKeywords, FocusConstructors at 100% of run cases; dynamic node tests and the item axis need fn:jkey/fn:jvalue (2.17); NamedFunctionRef's failures are missing functions. XP40 23,698 to 24,206.
